WhatsApp announced several new features on its blog today, including support for sharing Apple Music and Spotify listening activity to WhatsApp Status, as well as changes to account settings for iPad.

WhatsApp announces Apple Music sharing feature, iPad registration service and other updates

In addition to rolling out Adobe Acrobat PDF integration for the first time today, WhatsApp also announced a few recently added features.

One of the new features lets you share music you're listening to on Apple Music or Spotify directly to your WhatsApp Status. The blog post mentions:

We first spotted signs of this feature in development back in November last year, and WhatsApp says it has now officially launched.

Another change is that iPad users can now set up a WhatsApp account directly on their iPad, without needing to use a phone number. According to today's announcement, this feature has been a popular request from users since the first launch of WhatsApp for iPad.

Finally, the WhatsApp blog post also specifically mentions the recently upgraded CarPlay app, giving users much more to do than before.

Among all these new WhatsApp features, which one excites you the most? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
